requirements.requirement: Establish a persistent integrity baseline covering /etc on node1.
requirements.summary: AIDE was configured to cover /etc with content and security-attribute checks, and a 1,190-entry baseline database was created. The protected policy and database remained present with an unchanged database hash, and a clean check succeeded after restart.

requirements.requirement: Enable later changes under /etc to be identified and reported.
requirements.summary: A controlled content change to /etc/issue was directly detected and reported with changed size and SHA-256 values. After restoration, the check reported no differences. A persistent daily timer and latest-report file also provide ongoing reporting.

overall_summary: Both material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol was also completed for node1: a healthy pre-restart state and boot identity were captured, restart scheduling was acknowledged, a different boot identity appeared, and the AIDE package, timer, baseline hash, report, and clean integrity state recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: The daily timer was shown enabled, active, scheduled, and persistent, but its next natural calendar-triggered execution was not observed; direct manual service executions did verify report generation.
Lifecycle snapshots provide only bounded system-health inventories and do not independently enumerate the AIDE files, so task-specific final state relies primarily on the captured executor commands.

operational_hygiene.summary: Implementation mutations were causally related to installation, configuration, behavioral verification, correction of boot-time metadata noise, or the required restart protocol. Controlled changes to /etc were restored, package health remained good, no failed services or new listening sockets appeared, and the final restart showed recovery. The only unnecessary retained mutations were two abandoned scratch output files: /tmp/aide-etc-init.out, created by cmd-ba6fec9fdc0d47c1, and /tmp/aide-etc-rebaseline.out, created by cmd-2c0a2457c96b45e3 and later rewritten by cmd-bce2e2dfd9f94902; both remained in the final temporary-file inventory.
